entities.summary: Michael James Delligatti was an American entrepreneur. He was an early franchisee of the fast food restaurant chain McDonald's, opening the first of his eventual 48 branches in Uniontown, Pennsylvania, in 1957. Delligatti is famously known as the creator of McDonald's "Big Mac" hamburger in 1967.
